## Step 1: Create the integration

1. Open WSO2 Integrator.
2. Select **Skip for now**.
3. Select **Create New Integration**.
4. Set **Integration Name** to `SetupGuide`.
5. Set **Project Name** to `azure-ai-search-setup-guide`.
6. Select **Create Integration**.
7. Select **SetupGuide**.

## Step 2: Create an Azure AI Search service

1. <!-- manual: Sign in to the [Azure Portal](https://portal.azure.com). -->
2. Select **Create a resource** and search for **AI Search**.
3. Select **AI Search** and select **Create**.
4. <!-- manual: Fill in the required details: -->
5. <!-- manual: Resource group: Select an existing resource group or create a new one. -->
6. <!-- manual: Service name: Enter a unique name (this becomes part of your endpoint URL). -->
7. <!-- manual: Location: Select a region close to your application. -->
8. <!-- manual: Pricing tier: Select a tier based on your needs (the Free tier is available for testing). -->
9. Select **Review + create**, then **Create** to provision the service.

## Step 3: Get the service URL and admin key

1. Once the service is deployed, navigate to your Azure AI Search service in the Azure Portal.
2. <!-- manual: In the Overview section, note the URL — for example, https://your-service.search.windows.net. -->
3. <!-- manual: Navigate to Settings › Keys in the left menu. -->
4. <!-- manual: Copy either the Primary admin key or Secondary admin key. -->
